scope: Kernel-generic configuration and analysis; current backend gwatch0.0.35/SM90/ELF ABI8, not a universal ISA backend
shared_entry_note: SWA and FA1 are different runtime modes/site groups of one entry, as confirmed by the user

workload_scope.moe_swa: genuine captured model inputs, actual TP8 SWA+MoE PDL chain
workload_scope.fa1_fa2: bounded synthetic MiMo Pro-shaped inputs, actual TP8 IPC destinations and FA1+FA2 PDL chain

timing_scope: Whole communicating chain; setup/gate/reset excluded; per-call rank MAX then paired-round median; not isolated kernel overhead or local phase error
limitations: Only the documented SM90/version/layout/direct-call ABI is enabled
Conservative caller/role analysis can reject feasible but unsupported sites
New kernels/shapes/sites still need output/coverage/perturbation checks
Positive/negative timing variation must not be called universal profiler slowdown/speedup
provenance: Historical 2026-10-23 regression summary; raw workloads and logs are not distributed in this package.
